new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, Taiwan Lab & Partner Engineering
new_jobs.jd: **Overview** Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) delivers the foundational infrastructure and technologies that power Microsoft’s cloud and online services. Within SCHIE, Cloud Hardware Systems Engineering (CHSE) supports the engineering and delivery of cloud hardware with a focus on quality, scale, and predictable execution. We are seeking a Principal Program Manager, Taiwan Lab & Partner Engineering, to lead early-stage design and engineering collaboration with Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs) and Contract Manufacturers (CMs). This senior individual contributor will align Taiwan lab readiness, resource priorities, and partner commitments with program needs. Bridging Taiwan, US, and global labs, you will enable two-way sharing of expertise, best practices, and capabilities, reduce cross-region friction, and improve engineering efficiency, quality, and delivery predictability. **Responsibilities** * Lead Taiwan-based early-stage design and engineering programs with ODM/CM and Microsoft engineering partners, translating program priorities into aligned outcomes and effective local execution. * Align Taiwan lab support, readiness, and resource priorities with engineering demand. Influence capacity and capability decisions to improve program efficiency while balancing competing needs. * Establish joint delivery accountability with ODM/CM engineering partners, aligning commitments, dependencies, and expectations to improve quality and delivery predictability. * Connect Taiwan, US, and global labs through two-way sharing of engineering expertise, best practices, resources, and capabilities. Promote reuse and reduce time-zone and remote-management friction. * Lead cross-organizational resolution of program risks, dependencies, and decisions in partnership with existing engineering and operational owners. Clarify tradeoffs and drive issues to closure without duplicating technical ownership. * Use program evidence and partner feedback to identify improvements in local engineering execution and lab collaboration. Scale practices that strengthen readiness, quality, resource effectiveness, and business outcomes. * Communicate program health, priorities, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. Build alignment on decisions and resource tradeoffs across Taiwan partners and global engineering leadership. * Shape Taiwan lab and engineering partner collaboration strategy with engineering, sourcing, and operations leaders. Align partner capabilities with evolving program needs while respecting established commercial and operational ownership. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience. * 5+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs across engineering, operations, hardware, infrastructure, manufacturing, lab, or supply chain environments. * Experience establishing operating mechanisms that align program priorities, ownership, dependencies, and delivery commitments across teams. * Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience. * Experience with hardware development lifecycles, engineering labs, manufacturing, or engineering collaboration with ODM/CM partners. * Experience in product hardware design or validation, including working with engineering teams to define requirements, execute verification plans, analyze test results, and drive issue resolution through development milestones. * Experience leading programs across multinational, matrixed engineering and partner organizations, including collaboration across Taiwan, US, or other global teams. * Strong analytical skills and experience using data to assess program health, inform resource tradeoffs, and improve quality and delivery predictability. * Demonstrated ability to scale engineering collaboration and reuse lab capabilities, resources, and best practices across teams or regions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin Chinese, with the ability to engage local engineering partners and global stakeholders. * Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role, including Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about **requesting accommodations.**

new_jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist (Enterprise Solution)
new_jobs.jd: **About Appier** Appier (TSE: 4180) is an AI-native Agentic AI as a Service (AaaS) company that empowers businesses to create value through cutting-edge AdTech and MarTech solutions. Founded in 2012 with the vision of “Making AI Easy by Making Software Intelligent,” Appier helps businesses turn AI into ROI through its Ad Cloud, Personalization Cloud, and Data Cloud—each powered by Agentic AI that enables autonomous, adaptive, and real-time decision-making. Today, Appier operates 17 offices across APAC, the US, and EMEA, and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Learn more at www.appier.com. **About The Role** We are looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Scientist** to join the Enterprise Solution Science Team. This team focuses on applying cutting-edge ML technologies to real-world marketing problems by combining them with omnichannel customer data. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end development, from problem definition to driving model deployment into production. **What You’ll Work On** * Work on one or more of the following topics: user intention prediction, user segmentation, product recommendation, campaign content optimization, and send time optimization * Collaborate with product teams to translate product goals and business needs into well-defined ML problems during the planning stage * Work closely with ML engineers to deploy models to production, ensuring reliability and maintainability * Conduct offline and online evaluation, monitoring, and continuous optimization of models after deployment * Stay up to date with the latest research and proactively propose innovative applications **What We’re Looking For (Minimum)** * Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. * 3+ years of experience applying ML techniques in areas such as prediction, optimization, segmentation, or recommendation. * Proficient in Python and commonly used ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Impact-driven mindset, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a continuous passion for learning cutting-edge technologies. * Proficient in AI-powered development tools such as: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex / Codex CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot. **What We’re Looking For (Preferred)** * Practical experience in deploying enterprise-grade ML models, including model pipeline and performance dashboard development. * Experience in cross-functional collaboration and leading industry projects. * Industry experience in MarTech and passion for building customer-centric products.

new_jobs.title: Market Access and Policy Advisor
new_jobs.jd: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position **Role scope** * Develop and implement market access strategies/solutions for strategic products covering reimbursement, pricing, pharmacoeconomics/HTA strategy, and policy-related strategy to maximize patient access and portfolio value * Shape sustainable pricing strategies from pre-launch through lifecycle management, aligned with overall portfolio and long-term business objectives * Prioritize pipeline assets and define access pathways to ensure successful future launches * Ensure payer relevant evidence is generated through clinical trials, health economic modeling, real-world evidence studies, systematic literature research and meta-analysis effectively to demonstrate the value comprehensively * Translate evidence into compelling value propositions tailored to Taiwan payer and policy environment * Identify patient access opportunities and/or issues/barriers and develop access solutions to address them and create access for patients for Roche innovations in self-pay market * Engage external stakeholders to remove access barriers and deliver value based discussion for Roche products * Reimbursement: + Work cross functionally with PPOC, Marketing, and Medical stakeholders to develop the reimbursement strategy and engagement plan with KOL and advocacy groups + Collect data and prepare a dossier for the National Health Insurance Administration (NHIA) submission. Highlight the key evidence and product value proposition for the payer + Support policy shaping activities to support patient access as appropriate + Lead negotiation and contracting processes to secure an optimal outcome for the company * Collaborate with the global team and other affiliates through the network to ensure alignment on the access and pricing strategy * Contribute to the planning and execution of our policy and health system shaping activities to ensure the system is ready and willing to recognize, value, and reimburse our future innovations Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. **Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
